notablePrerequisites:
You control creatures that can produce at least {5}{W}.
Chulane does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate creatures by tapping them, adding at least {5}{W}.
Cast Village Bell-Ringer by paying {2}{W}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
In response, activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Village Bell-Ringer from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Village Bell-Ringer trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat until your library is empty.
Cast and resolve Laboratory Maniac by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat stpes 1 through 3.
